description: Analyze and categorize available pull requests from Auto-Claude GitHub repository for contribution decisions
workflow_rationale: This task involves researching external GitHub pull requests without modifying local codebase. The goal is to gather, categorize, and present information to enable informed contribution decisions.

phases.name: Data Fetch
phases.description: Fetch pull request data from GitHub repository

subtasks.description: Fetch open PRs from Auto-Claude repository using webReader

verification.instructions: Verify pr_data_raw.json contains PR list with numbers, titles, and metadata

phases.name: Analysis
phases.description: Categorize PRs by complexity and technical scope

verification.instructions: Verify pr_analysis.md has PRs grouped by complexity with justifications

subtasks.description: Identify technical scope for each PR (backend/frontend/fullstack)

verification.instructions: Verify each PR has service classification (backend/frontend/fullstack)

subtasks.description: Extract metadata (task progress, reactions, draft status)

verification.instructions: Verify each PR includes task count, reaction count, and draft status

phases.name: Documentation
phases.description: Create comprehensive PR analysis document with recommendations

subtasks.description: Create executive summary with top recommendations

verification.instructions: Verify executive summary provides clear prioritized recommendations

subtasks.description: Compile PR listings by complexity (simple, medium, complex)

verification.instructions: Verify report includes all PRs organized by complexity sections

subtasks.description: Add technical requirements and rationale for each PR

verification.instructions: Verify each PR entry includes requirements and recommendation rationale

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential workflow - research depends on fetched data

verification_strategy.reasoning: Research/documentation task with no code modifications. Output verification through manual review of generated documentation.

checks: PR data accuracy verified against GitHub
Technical scope identified for each PR
